raw: {"analysis": "Both responses provide solid delivery plans addressing the key constraints: non-idempotent payments, fraud team sign-off, shared module interface, CI cost, flaky test, and immutable Gold artifacts. CST is more detailed and structured, explicitly listing binding facts, defining the safety criteria for retries, and including a cost-control cap on CI runs. It also prepares a hotfix branch in advance for rollback and includes an independent security review. NLV covers similar points but with less specificity on retry safety criteria and cost limits, and its rollback plan is slightly less concrete. Overall, CST offers a more actionable and comprehensive plan with fewer potential follow-up questions.", "verdict": "CST"}
